commentary: The confirm slot over the walks' own additions (commit 598f0c5a: 17 files, +594/-19 against the apply commit). Probed, not reasoned: the regenerated orbit-architect SKILL.md carries the three-production string exactly once and names its owner once; the production string has exactly one holder today (the rc15 delta — the baseline inherits it at sync, which is the single-active-owner lookup's whole point); the live `architecture status --json` carries `ended` and `ratified` as booleans on all 30 stages of both parseable docs (zero explore citers exist on the live docs, so the `concluded` flag's presence was confirmed through the engine suite's CLI test rather than the live tree); parser.ts imports no template module, so the new architect→parser import introduces no cycle; the baseline specs are untouched by both walks (the orientation sentences stayed OUT of cascade by rule, as option B requires). Every prior finding of the pair is resolved on the tree with its evidence listed. The one residual is record-truth, not mechanism: the walk's second pin move is written in the parity test and both logs but not under the task that recorded the first — the same class the walk itself just repaired in proposal and design. Lenses remain absent, so passes 4 and 5 are skipped by the degradation rule; pass 4's adopter perspective was exercised through the §5 probe above. Risk texture: the pair's two WARNINGs were disjoint and both prose-side; nothing in the composition logic, the parser, or the render moved during the walks except the exported constant, and the fifteen-cell table plus the full suite (2376) stood green throughout.
